python3 -c "
from text import reverse_words

cases = [
    (reverse_words('hello world'), 'world hello'),
    (reverse_words('hello'), 'hello'),
    (reverse_words('one two three'), 'three two one'),
    (reverse_words('  foo   bar  '), 'bar foo'),
    (reverse_words(''), ''),
]
for got, expected in cases:
    status = 'PASS' if got == expected else f'FAIL (got {got!r})'
    print(f'{status}: expected {expected!r}')
" 2>&1
